posts.body:
Hi Everyone,
I am new to this site so hope this is ok, I was thinking that I know a lot of us mums do party plan businesses and that it is good to get parties from people out of our circle of friends! So I thought that maybe people might want to do part swaps? It's a fun way to make new friends and improve our businesses at the same time!
Let me know what you think?
I am a Pampered Chef consultant based in Grays, Essex
Renee

I think that would probably be a very good idea but I dont do party plan anymore.  Good luck with it.
x

Hi am an Usborne books at home organiser
usborne produce quality books for children from cloth/bath books for babies right through to great fiction and reference books for teenagers.
As a party host you receive up to 20% of sales in FREE books of your choice and once sales go above £150 you receive £15 worth of books at 1/2 price.
www.childrensbooks4u.co.uk
(bare with the website currently updating)
I can do party swaps in west yorkshire/east lancashire but do have team all over the uk so if you'd like an usborne party just pm me.

I am a Truly Madly Baby Consultant for the Northants/Milton Keynes area but we have over 200 consultants covering the UK so chances are there will be someone in or near your area.
Invite your friends and family round and in the comfort of your living room choose from a wide range of beautiful gifts and products for mother, baby and children up to 5 years old. You won't be disappointed as all the products are of a very high quality
As a party host you will get 10% commission on your guests sales and a fantastic FREE gift experience from Venture worth £165. If your friends buy over £300 worth of products you can also have a free half price gift too.
www.trulymadlybaby.co.uk
I would quite fancy party swapping with a Mini IQ agent.
